result.description:
Immediate Start Available
We are seeking a reliable and motivated MR Truck Driver / Process Worker to join our team. This is a diverse role offering a great mix of driving and hands-on warehouse/processing duties, with approximately 2 days per week driving and 3 days per week process work.

About the Role
This dual-role position is ideal for someone who enjoys variety in their workday. You will be responsible for the safe operation of an MR truck for deliveries, while also supporting our clients processing operations to ensure products are prepared, handled, and dispatched efficiently.

Key Responsibilities
MR Truck Driver Duties (3 Days Per Week)

Safely operate a Medium Rigid (MR) truck.
Complete local deliveries.
Load and unload vehicles as required.
Conduct daily vehicle inspections and maintain logbooks.
Ensure all deliveries are completed safely and on schedule.
Provide professional customer service when dealing with clients and suppliers.

Process Worker Duties (2 Days Per Week)

Operate processing and production equipment.
Sort, prepare, pack, and label products.
Maintain quality standards and follow production procedures.
Assist with stock handling and inventory management.
Keep work areas clean and compliant with workplace safety standards.
Support the wider team with general operational tasks.

About You
To be successful in this role, you will have:

Current MR Truck Licence (essential).
Good driving record and commitment to safe work practices.
Ability to perform physical work, including lifting and manual handling.
Strong work ethic and reliability.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Good communication skills.
Forklift licence (desirable but not essential).
Previous experience in transport, warehouse, manufacturing, or process work highly regarded.

What We Offer

Casual employment with full-time hours.
Varied role with a mix of driving and operational work.
Supportive team environment.
Competitive hourly rate based on experience.
Opportunity for growth and development.

How to Apply
If you are a dependable MR driver looking for a varied role combining driving and process work, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now by submitting your resume OR contact Flexiforce directly on (02) 4869 5505.

Type: Full-time

Location: Helensvale QLD 4212
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business:
Glory Hair And Beauty Pty Ltd is a professional barbershop and hairdressing business operating within Westfield Helensvale, delivering quality cutting, styling and grooming services to a diverse local clientele. The business focuses on skilled, client-centred hairdressing in a clean, welcoming retail environment and values reliability, attention to detail, strong customer service and a collaborative team culture that prioritises both technical excellence and a positive client experience.
About the Position:
The Hairdresser role is a full-time position responsible for delivering high-quality haircutting, styling and grooming services that meet client expectations and support the smooth day-to-day operation of the Helensvale salon. The position plays a key part in maintaining service standards, building client loyalty and contributing to the overall success and reputation of Glory Hair And Beauty Pty Ltd.
Key Responsibilities:
Perform a full range of hairdressing services including cutting, styling, colouring, treatments and grooming for male and female clients
Consult with clients to determine their preferences, provide professional advice and recommend suitable products or services
Maintain high standards of hygiene, cleanliness and presentation of the workstation, tools and salon environment
Manage appointment bookings, client records and efficient workflow during busy periods
Uphold workplace health and safety standards and follow salon policies and procedures
Contribute to a positive team environment and support colleagues as required
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply
Minimum Certificate III in Hairdressing, Hairstyling or a related field
Minimum 2–3 years of experience as a hairdresser
Strong technical hairdressing skills, excellent client communication and interpersonal abilities, and the capacity to work effectively in a busy salon environment

To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Salary: $79,425 plus 12% superannuation per annum
Hours: Full-time, 38 hours per week

Tiny's Sandwich Bar is looking for an experienced Cook to join our team. This is a full-time, ongoing position, working 38 hours per week, based in Sydney CBD, NSW.

The Cook will be responsible for the following duties:
Prepare, season and cook a variety of food items in accordance with established recipes and quality standards.
Assist with food preparation for daily service, ensuring ingredients are prepared efficiently and safely.
Portion, plate and present meals consistently to meet the venue's quality and presentation standards.
Ensure all food is prepared and served in a timely manner during busy service periods.
Monitor food quality throughout preparation and cooking to maintain consistency and customer satisfaction.
Store food appropriately and rotate stock in accordance with food safety requirements.
Assist with receiving, checking and storing deliveries of food supplies.
Maintain a clean and organised workstation and assist in keeping kitchen equipment and utensils clean and in good working order.
Follow all food safety, hygiene and workplace health and safety procedures at all times.
Assist with stock control by reporting low stock levels and minimising food waste through proper portion control and storage practices.
Work collaboratively with the Head Chef, Sous Chef and other kitchen staff to ensure smooth daily kitchen operations.

What we're looking for:
- At least 2 years of experience working as a Cook in a commercial kitchen.
- Certificate III in Commercial Cookery (or equivalent) is preferred but not essential where sufficient industry experience can be demonstrated.
- A valid Food Safety Certificate (or equivalent) and a sound understanding of NSW food safety and hygiene standards.
- Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong teamwork skills, reliability and attention to detail.

SENIOR PIGGERY STOCKPERSON 
Location: Mount Mercer, VIC 3352 
Tenure: Full-time Permanent 
Salary: From $71,481 per year (plus superannuation) 

Required Skills and Experience:
•	AQF Certificate III (or higher/equivalent) qualification in Agriculture (Pig Production);
•	At least 3 years recent relevant experience in a medium to large size commercial piggery

Position Summary: 
On behalf of our client, Global Skilled Employment Services is looking for a skilled and experienced Senior Piggery Stockperson who can join the production team of a piggery company with multiple farm sites. 
Must have strong communication and time management skills, self-motivated and must have the ability to work independently and as a member of a team.
Tasks and duties include: 
•	Supervise the site and facilities in terms of the required human resources, physical resources, safety requirements, consumables, documentation and measurement devices
•	Provide overall maintenance and compliance of the Company Quality Assurance program for the site ensuring that all relevant documentation is kept current;
•	Supervise data collection and recording so information is accurate to aid stock and inventory control
•	Undertake specific tasks assigned by management to ensure that environmental, quality and safety goals are met
•	Implement preventable maintenance programs to reduce planned and unplanned down time
•	Supervise trial sheds, collect and record data in accordance with trial protocols
•	Selection of breeding stock and/or pigs for sale
•	Supervision and participation of daily inspection of livestock, such that the animals are appropriately fed, watered, environmental parameters are fulfilled. The Senior Stockperson (Piggery) in this case would work with and supervise a less experienced Stockperson
•	Supervision and participation of daily inspection of livestock, ensuring compromised animals are individually assessed, identified, treated and record in accordance with the Company Herd Health Plan and the industries Model Code of Practice
•	Euthanise sick or injured stock in a humane manner and in accordance with the Model Code of Practice for Animal Welfare – Pigs 3rd edition
•	Conduct post mortem examinations of deceased stock and report findings
•	Supervision and participation in the mating of animals via individually supervised mating or through Artificial Insemination
•	Supervision of the birthing process, including the ability to physically conduct unsupervised internal assessments of females during parturition to minimise this incidence of still births
•	Participate in company/industry training sessions and workshops as required;
•	Perform any other duty as required by the Unit Manager.

Other skills required:
•	Good verbal and written communication skills;
•	Advanced and extensive knowledge in animal husbandry, animal welfare, and pig production;
•	Knowledge in using computer system is an advantage.

Qualified applicants may apply online.

result.description:
About the Organisation
Twisted Sista Global Pty Ltd is an established and expanding café and gelateria
group, operating multiple franchised locations across Victoria. The brand is
recognised for its innovative menu offerings, high-volume service environment, and
strong operational systems.
As part of our continued growth, we are seeking to appoint an Executive Chef to lead
culinary operations across our network.
The Opportunity
This is a senior leadership position responsible for the strategic and operational
direction of all food-related functions across six (6) franchise locations.
The role requires a highly experienced professional capable of
delivering consistency, scalability, and innovation within a multi-site environment.
Key Responsibilities
? Lead the planning, development, implementation, and continuous
improvement of food menus, recipes, and seasonal offerings across all
venues within the group.
? Develop, standardise, and maintain recipes, portion controls, plating
specifications, and food presentation standards to ensure consistency and
quality across kitchen operations.
? Oversee kitchen operations and monitor food preparation methods, cooking
standards, and presentation quality across all locations to ensure consistency
with brand and culinary standards.
? Supervise, train, and mentor kitchen staff, head chefs, and franchise kitchen
teams in food preparation techniques, kitchen procedures, food safety
standards, and presentation requirements.
? Develop and implement kitchen operational procedures and production
workflows to improve efficiency, consistency, and service standards across
multiple sites.
? Coordinate supplier sourcing and procurement of food products and kitchen
supplies, while monitoring food costs, stock usage, wastage, and portion
control measures.
? Ensure compliance with food safety legislation, hygiene regulations, kitchen
sanitation requirements, and safe food handling procedures across all kitchen
operations.
? Support the establishment of new store locations by assisting with kitchen
setup, menu implementation, workflow planning, and training of kitchen
personnel.
? Conduct regular audits of kitchen operations, food quality, storage
procedures, and presentation standards, and implement corrective actions
where required.
? Collaborate with senior management regarding menu direction, product
development, and operational improvements to support business growth and
customer satisfaction.
Essential Requirements
? Diploma or higher qualification in a closely related filed (e.g. Kitchen
Management/Commercial Cookery/Hospitality Management), or else 3 years
of relevant working experience in lieu of formal qualifications.
? Minimum 3 years’ experience as a Chef in a busy commercial kitchen,
including leadership responsibilities
? In-depth knowledge of Australian food safety standards and compliance
frameworks
? Ability to travel between locations as required
Highly Regarded
? Experience in a senior culinary leadership role (Executive Chef / Group Chef /
Head Chef – Multi-site)
To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter outlining your relevant
experience and suitability for the role.

Pay: $95,000.00 – $115,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
